market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.4m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Venezuela production ~1.0-1.1m bpd in early 2026. Goldman forecasts flat at 900K. Optimistic US Energy Sec range tops out at ~1.4M. Reaching 1.4m would require near-best-case investment + political stability. Possible but unlikely.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sanctions relief and PDVSA capex pace.
